name: Mao
source: Mao is an outcast of society, being part human with animal ears and a tail. He is discovered by the LWC when he causes a commotion in town, and they take him under their care. Originally not speaking the language of the humans, Mao learns quickly though speaks very slowly and broken. He has a very innocent personality, and a huge appetite that causes him to try to eat just about anything.
